$comment: BSC TESTNET home chain. rpcUrl is a public endpoint, spelled out the way PRUV's is, so a deploy
needs no extra environment variable; swap it for a private one if rate limits bite.
A SECOND networks file, not an edit of networks.json: 1.3.1 is live on Sepolia and staging
resolves against it, so the operational config must keep working untouched. Lead ruling
2026-09-18: BSC testnet is the home chain for staging, BSC mainnet for production; Sepolia
stays only as the 1.3.1 deployment.
**THE USDC LEG IS 18-DECIMAL (Derryl's 2026-09-18 replacement set, built to match mainnet).**
This is the first deployment in which ADR-028's cross-decimal path is exercised at all. Measured
BSC     usdcWarpRoute 0x1517A8..10Ff  collateral, wraps 0x867FBB..af84 (FakeUSDC, 18 dp), scale() = 1
PRUV    usdcWarpRoute 0x72404d68..D51E collateral, wraps 0x756EfF..4cBE (FakeUSDC,  6 dp), scale() = 1e12
Sepolia (same pair)   0x9495AC..FF2d   collateral, wraps 0x756EfF..4cBE,               scale() = 1e12
`scale * 10^decimals` is 1e18 on every leg, which is the invariant postDeploy asserts -- and on
this pair that assertion is a REAL check for the first time instead of a tautology at 6/6.
**ADR-028 OQ-3 is answered** by driving the deployed Sepolia route's own `handle`: a wire amount
of 1e18 pays out exactly 1e6 locally, so inbound DIVIDES by scale, exactly as D7 assumed
(contracts/test/fork/ScaleConvention.t.sol).
The wRWA leg is unchanged and still 6-decimal on all three chains: BSC's route IS the ERC-20
(synthetic), PRUV's is collateral over the vault 0x5d5C78..7370.
The FUND block's usdcWarpRoute is the NEW PRUV route, because that is the one BSC is enrolled
with -- config/networks.json still points at the operational 0x725e38fc..c16A for 1.3.1.
rexRegistry and rexLens are null on purpose: both are per-home-chain REX deployments and neither
exists on BSC yet. They are filled in by the deploy, exactly as Sepolia's were.
rexRegistryV2 (ADR-032): the flat v2 directory, deployed 2026-09-28 and holding the four live
funds. rexRegistry (v1) stays
recorded while a v1 instance is live and BE6 has not cut over; the two are independent
contracts, not versions of one address.
